sents.zh: 金朝有一个很喜欢读书的人。
sents.en: In the Jin dynasty there was a man who loved to read.

sents.zh: 他家里没有钱，可是有很多书。
sents.en: His family was not rich, but had many books.

sents.zh: 他每天早上一起来就看书。
sents.en: Every morning he read as soon as he got up.

sents.zh: 他看什么都看，历史、诗，还有别的。
sents.en: He read everything — history, poems and more.

sents.zh: 他有一个本子，一直放在身上。
sents.en: He kept a notebook with him at all times.

sents.zh: 看到好的东西，他就马上写下来。
sents.en: Whenever he saw something good, he wrote it down at once.

sents.zh: 他也把自己想到的写在下面。
sents.en: He wrote his own thoughts underneath.

sents.zh: 一年一年过去，本子越来越多。
sents.en: Year after year the notebooks piled up.

sents.zh: 他把它们都放在一个大箱里。
sents.en: He kept them all in a large chest.

sents.zh: 后来他老了，眼睛不好，不能再写了。
sents.en: Later he grew old, his eyes failed, and he could write no more.

sents.zh: 他把箱子给了自己的学生。
sents.en: He gave the chest to his students.

sents.zh: 很多年以后，别人还在看这些本子。
sents.en: Many years later people were still reading those notebooks.

sents.zh: 因为里面有他一生看到的东西。
sents.en: Because in them was everything he had seen in his life.

sents.zh: 所以有人说，他的书一直在教人。
sents.en: So it was said that his books went on teaching.

sents.zh: 他自己说过：“不写下来，很快就忘了。”
sents.en: He himself had said: "If you do not write it down, you soon forget."
